rows.ARS:
Pink blend Shrub.
Registration name: Wekruneflo
Exhibition name: Yabba Dabba Doo
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, before 2009).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2013 as 'Yabba Dabba Doo'.
rows.Bloom: Coral-pink, yellow center, lighter reverse. Mild, tea fragrance. 7 to 11 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium, single to semi-double, cluster-flowered, in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 39" to 4'1" (100 to 125cm). Width: 4'1" to 7'5" (125 to 225cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or garden.
